crossRefs.note: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and…
but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;
For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

translations.web: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.
translations.bsb: Then he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar for carrying it. He made the altar with boards so that it was hollow.
translations.kjv: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
translations.asv: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, wherewith to bear it; he made it hollow with planks.
